Ring VRF Verification [WIP]
=========================

.. warning::
   This documentation is a work in progress.

Overview
-------
The Ring VRF module provides verification functions for:

* IETF VRF Proofs [TBD]
* Pedersen VRF Proofs [TBD] 
* Ring Proofs [TBD]
* Pedersen Ring VRF Proofs [TBD]
